_readme: Content for /outside-context/resources (page: outside-context-resources.html). Edit, save, deploy. Sections show in this order. A section has a name, an optional intro line, and either items or numbered steps (each step: name + items). Each item: title (the link text), url (https), note (one line), tag (optional small label, e.g. Free).

categories.name: Learn the basics
categories.intro: Start here. No background needed for the first one.

items.title: Prompt Engineering Interactive Tutorial (Anthropic)
items.note: Nine short chapters on getting better answers from AI. Has a Google Sheets version if you don't code.

items.title: ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers (DeepLearning.AI)
items.note: A short course for people who write code. Needs basic Python.

items.title: Agentic AI, taught by Andrew Ng (DeepLearning.AI)
items.note: How AI agents plan, use tools and check their own work. About ten hours of video.
items.tag: Free to watch, certificate is paid

categories.name: Own your AI
categories.intro: You don't need anyone's permission, subscription or server to use AI. Here's how to run it yourself.

steps.name: Run a model on your laptop

items.title: LM Studio
items.note: The easiest way to start. Pick a model, click download, start chatting. Nothing leaves your computer.

items.title: Jan
items.note: An open-source alternative to ChatGPT that runs fully offline.

items.title: Ollama
items.note: For developers. One command to run a model and get a local API.

items.title: GPT4All
items.note: Works on older laptops with no graphics card.

items.title: Kiwix
items.note: Download all of Wikipedia, plus medical references and repair guides, and read them with no internet.

items.title: Project N.O.M.A.D.
items.note: Offline Wikipedia, local AI, maps and courses in one install. A weekend project; needs a Linux machine.

items.title: Kolibri
items.note: Khan Academy-style courses that work offline.

items.title: Project Gutenberg
items.note: Over 75,000 free books to download and keep.

items.title: Internet Archive
items.note: A free library of books, recordings and archived websites.

items.title: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
items.note: An open-source agent that runs on your machine and keeps its memory there. Free to run; you pay for a model unless you connect a local one.

items.title: Hugging Face
items.note: Where open AI models are published. Browse what you can run yourself.
